cover.coreProposition: Progressive skill compression must preserve public callable entries, route reachability, resource classifications and version/provenance; routing evidence is necessary but not sufficient for semantic, permission or effect equivalence.
cover.visualMetaphor: A modular structure is compressed inward while luminous routes and public entry nodes remain connected
cover.semanticObject: Two aligned layered structures, one expanded and one compact, sharing the same bright entry nodes and branching paths
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with an expanded routed bundle transforming into a smaller structure while the entry topology remains visually traceable
